verdict.rationale: Trip-based expense grouping is a fair axis for an expense-management product. The evidence covers cards, budgets, auto-categorized transactions and reimbursements, but nothing on travel bookings, itineraries, or automatically assembling a trip's bookings, card charges and receipts into one linked report. Categorizing individual transactions is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an employee, a trip's expenses — bookings, cards, receipts — collect themselves into one itinerary-linked report
